sections.title: Softening a no
sections.content: sajnos ("unfortunately") softens a "no" and usually comes right at the start, followed by the reason with mert. It's the polite way to turn down an invitation without sounding blunt.

items.spanish: Sajnos nem tudok jönni, mert nincs időm.
items.english: Unfortunately I can't come, because I don't have time.

items.spanish: Sajnos nincs időm ma este, de majd legközelebb!
items.english: Unfortunately I don't have time tonight, but maybe next time!

sections.content: majd legközelebb ("next time") is the standard follow-up after a sajnos decline — it keeps the door open and shows you'd genuinely like to join another time, not just brushing the invitation off.
